home.pageDescription: A tool developed to help coordinate medical equipment between countries.

workspace.title: One medicine. Across languages.
workspace.description: Find a medication, then explore its names by language and country.
workspace.selectDescription: Choose a search result to explore available names in another language and country.
workspace.retrySearch: Check the message above and try again.
workspace.noMatchesDescription: Try another name or broaden your language filters.
workspace.emptyDescription: Search by medication or brand name. Your matching results will appear here.
workspace.destinationHint: Choose a destination to look up available names.
workspace.accountHelp: Need an account? Your administrator can help.

search.title: Search medications
search.body: Enter a medication or brand name, choose a language, and select Search. Pick a result to view translation options.

translate.title: Translate a selected result
translate.body: Choose the target language and country, then select Translate. Changing the selection or destination clears the previous translation.

scan.title: Scan a medication
scan.body: Choose Scan medication, select an image and run the scan. Select Use in Search to copy a recognized term into the search field.

import.title: Import language files
import.body: Choose a JSON file with a language code and terms array. A successful import refreshes the available languages.

populate.title: Populate sources
populate.body: Select the sources to load and supply API credentials when required. Progress and errors appear in the population panel.

tools.populationCredentialsRequired: Enter the required credentials for the selected sources.
tools.filterSubtitle: Select which languages to enable across search and translation features
tools.importSubtitle: Upload a standardized .json language pack to Neo4j
tools.jsonExtension: The file must have a .json extension.
tools.jsonObject: The JSON must be a valid object.
tools.packFormat: The pack must include language.code and a terms array.
tools.jsonInvalid: The file is not valid JSON.
tools.selectPack: Please select a valid .json file first.
tools.ocrSubtitle: Extract medication text and find fuzzy matches in the knowledge graph
tools.imageFormats: PNG, JPG, JPEG or WEBP, up to 10 MB
tools.selectTerm: Select a term to search directly
tools.invalidImage: Please upload a valid image file (PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP).
tools.emptyImage: This image is empty. Please choose another file.
tools.largeImage: Please choose an image no larger than 10 MB.
tools.selectImage: Please select or drop an image file first.
tools.noText: No drug names or text recognized in this image.
tools.noTranslation: No translation found for the selected language

export.title: Export medications
export.rangeHint: Optional. Includes both names; leave blank for all medications.
export.invalidRange: Start name must come before or match end name.
export.empty: No medications match these filters. Try a wider range or another dataset.
